description: Create a deal in Pipedrive. Pass any additional Pipedrive field in `fields`, keyed by its field key/name (call the matching list_pipedrive_*_fields tool first to discover custom field keys and, for enum/set fields, their option ids). Common fields: value, currency, person_id, org_id, stage_id, user_id (owner), status.

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)
